topic.title: trick: train a smiles to MS/MS predictor too!
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Old experienced kaggler will know what this is for! Maybe ChatGPT and Claude know too.

required for competition:
backward : generator(MS/MS, adduct) = smiles (de novo)

useful:
forward: predictor(smiles, adduct)= MS/MS
(especially open-source predictor)

comments.content: i remember a comment from a past competition that their winners generated 1TB or more training data

Enveda’s GrAFF-MS model Efficiently predicting high resolution mass spectra with graph neural networks https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/murphy23a/murphy23a.pdf

note: "We train our model on the NIST-20 tandem MS library" https://github.com/murphy17/graff-ms

replies.content:
my orginal idea is some RSI harness + forward/backward spectrum to molecule modelling. But it seems this idea has been partially explored
https://github.com/ChrisTho23/dMSdMol

QOUTE: "Since models for both the forward (e.g., CFM-ID and GrAFF-MS) and backward problem (e.g., MS2Mol) have already been developed, we found this two-way approach to be very promising. We pursued a cycle contrastive GAN architecture, which allows us to create mappings between mass spectra and molecular structures, learning directly from the data in both directions."
